text: Triscion of Elementary Geometry. They soon perceived that such problems cannot be solved by any combination of mere straight lines or circles. To this conclusion they were held directly by the application of _Gometricical Analysis_, a beautiful instrument of discovery which. Place had recently invented or improved. Their investigations carried some curves of a higher order than the circle, and opened to them a wide and interesting field of research.
